OBJECT Codeunit 50003 Unused Param
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=21.11.26;
    Time=12:00:00;
    Modified=Yes;
    Version List=TEST;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
  }
  CODE
  {
    PROCEDURE Calculate@1(AmountP@1000 : Decimal;UnusedParamP@1001 : Integer) Result : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      // CAL003: UnusedParamP must produce a warning without altering signature
      Result := AmountP * 2;
    END;

    BEGIN
    END.
  }
}
